selected: precompute both timepoint names and all three built-in rule names for each supported task position
method: JS release drivers. Library samples time 1,000 constructions, with nine retained samples in each of three process pairs. CLI samples include startup, input and output and peak RSS. Each CLI comparison has nine samples per binary and workload after two warmup pairs; outputs are compared by byte. In reverse runs the candidate binary is passed first. Controls use the same baseline binary twice.

suffixConversions.method: The probe counts task index conversions before the dependency loop. The probe timing includes warmups, counters, validation, and timer overhead. The timed comparison uses the original executable without probes. The selected module precomputes 24 suffixes once, with no task index conversions in the constructor.
